one_line: Nurse of Mewar who, in later tradition, saves child-prince Udai Singh during Banvir’s usurpation after the fall of Chittor.

appearance.age_look: Early to mid 30s, lean but sturdy build, the grounded strength of a working royal nurse rather than a courtly lady.
appearance.face: Oval face with high cheekbones, medium wheatish-brown Rajasthani complexion, straight nose, slightly arched brows, a small tilak of red kumkum at the centre of her forehead, a faint vertical worry line between the brows, and calm, resolute eyes that default to a soft but intensely protective expression.
appearance.hair: Long black hair parted in the middle, oiled and gathered into a low bun at the nape, fully covered by a modest dupatta; she wears that dupatta pulled a bit forward over her head and pinned near the right temple with a small brass hairpin.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate working-woman Rajput attire: a full ghagra (long skirt) in muted dusty red cotton with a simple narrow golden-beige border at the hem, a knee-length kameez-style angarkha blouse in dull indigo-blue cotton that overlaps and ties slightly to the right with thin inner and outer fabric ties, and a long odhani/dupatta of light, soft off-white cotton with sparse block-printed tiny maroon dots and a thin indigo edge, draped over her head and one shoulder and brought across the torso for modesty; she wears simple brass bangles on both wrists, small round brass stud earrings, a thin black-bead-and-gold mangalsutra-style necklace, plain silver anklets, and a narrow cloth kamarband (waist sash) in faded mustard yellow that also supports a small cloth pouch at her right hip; her feet are in plain brown leather mojari-style slippers, practical rather than ornate.
appearance.signature: A sturdy rectangular woven reed basket with a fitted cloth cover in off-white, large enough to conceal an infant or small child, carried in the crook of her left arm or held with both hands, with a faint dark stain on one corner of the cloth and a simple knotted rope handle; tucked at her waist inside the kamarband, she also keeps a short wooden-handled bronze-bladed household knife used for cutting fruit and rope, but this remains a secondary, barely visible tool compared to the ever-present basket.

ref_desc: Panna Dai is a resolute early-30s Rajput nurse with an oval wheatish face, long black hair in a low bun under an off-white dupatta, wearing a dusty red ghagra, indigo angarkha blouse, mustard kamarband, simple brass jewellery, brown mojari slippers, and always carrying a covered woven reed basket.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character model sheet of Panna Dai, a historically grounded Rajput nurse from 1530s Mewar: an early-30s woman with an oval wheatish-brown face, high cheekbones, calm but intensely protective eyes, a small red kumkum tilak, and long black hair parted center and gathered into a low bun entirely covered by a modest off-white cotton dupatta pinned at her right temple with a small brass hairpin. Show her wearing a full dusty-red cotton ghagra with a narrow golden-beige border at the hem, a knee-length dull indigo-blue cotton angarkha blouse overlapping and tying slightly to the right, and a long off-white cotton odhani/dupatta with sparse tiny maroon dots and a thin indigo edge draped over her head and across her torso. Include simple brass bangles on both wrists, small round brass stud earrings, a thin black-bead-and-gold necklace, plain silver anklets, and a narrow mustard-yellow cloth kamarband at her waist that supports a small cloth pouch at her right hip; put plain brown leather mojari slippers on her feet. Her signature prop is a sturdy rectangular woven reed basket with a fitted off-white cloth cover and a rope handle, sized to hide a small child, held close in the crook of her left arm or with both hands, and a barely visible short wooden-handled bronze-bladed household knife tucked discreetly into her kamarband. Use a grounded, dignified shonen-anime look with slightly large expressive eyes but realistic proportions, and keep the colour palette dominated by dusty red, indigo blue, off-white, mustard yellow, and brass-gold, showing front, side, and back views that clearly display her consistent face, hair covering, garments, jewellery, slippers, and basket.
